description: Find the smallest candidates on an open page, as it is now, whose text, heading, label, id or classes contain every word, in at most 40 lines like open_page's. Says how many candidates the page gained since you last looked (+N new). If the page can't be read again, it is closed: open it again with open_page. After about 45 s it answers "still opening; call find again" while its page is still opening, or "still working; call find again" while its work goes on.
name: find
title: Find on a page
